prompt: A delivery note, the diff it describes, a load test log and a test log are supplied in the workspace. The note reads well and several of its sentences are checkable against the evidence it cites. Review it and write `review/findings.json` in the documented shape: every finding names the artifact it rests on, a claim the evidence supports is recorded as supported, a sentence no artifact carries is unsupported, and a requirement of the request that the draft never addresses is omitted-risk. The workspace is read only apart from your record file.

requirements: a latency claim whose quoted percentile and worker count both disagree with the cited log
a default flag claim the diff contradicts
a suite count the test log contradicts
a requirement of the request the draft never addresses
a second requirement of the request the draft never addresses
one claim that the evidence genuinely supports and must not be marked unsupported
fixture owned evidence and sources that must not be edited
paired same-model skill/no-skill execution from the identical starting snapshot

falsifiableChecks.assertion: The latency claim is marked unsupported and cites evidence/load-test.log, naming the percentile or the worker count mismatch.
The off by default claim is marked unsupported and cites evidence/diff.patch, where the flag is set to true.
The 214 passing tests claim is marked unsupported and cites evidence/test-run.log, which reports 212 passing and 2 skipped.
The unaddressed webhook budget requirement is recorded as an omission.
The unaddressed runbook requirement is recorded as an omission.
The unit test coverage claim, which src/rate-limit.test.ts supports, is not recorded as unsupported.
The verdict is bounded to the documented vocabulary and does not accept a delivery that carries three contradicted claims.

evidence: latency claim rejected against the load log
default flag contradiction found in the diff
suite count corrected against the test log
findings point at the sentence that is wrong rather than at the delivery as a whole
details say what the evidence shows and what would make the claim true
omissions are separated from contradicted claims

requiredEvidence: per claim finding with an existing evidence path
omission findings naming the unaddressed requirement
